properties.name: model-cards:integration_means
properties.value: Load with transformers (v4.53.0+) via AutoModelForCausalLM/AutoTokenizer and tokenizer.apply_chat_template; /think and /no_think system prompt flags or enable_thinking kwarg; tool calling via xml_tools or python_tools; serve with vLLM and SGLang in an OpenAI-compatible API; local inference with llama.cpp, ONNX, MLX, MLC and ExecuTorch.

properties.name: model-cards:distribution_channels
properties.value: Open weights on Hugging Face (model, checkpoints, quantized checkpoints collection); can be deployed via vLLM and SGLang in an OpenAI-compatible API; local inference with llama.cpp, ONNX, MLX, MLC and ExecuTorch.

modelParameters.architectureFamily: Decoder-only transformer using GQA and NoPE (3:1 ratio)
modelParameters.modelArchitecture: Decoder-only transformer using GQA and NoPE (with 3:1 ratio); 3B parameters. The card gives no layer count, experts or active parameters, and no stated rationale beyond the design aim of pushing the boundaries of small models.

performanceMetrics.value: SmolLM3-3B (no extended thinking): AIME 2025 9.3, GSM-Plus 72.8, LiveCodeBench v4 15.2, GPQA Diamond 35.7, IFEval 76.7, MixEval Hard 26.9, BFCL 92.3, Global MMLU 53.5. Extended thinking: AIME 2025 36.7, GSM-Plus 83.4, LiveCodeBench v4 30.0, GPQA Diamond 41.7, IFEval 71.2, MixEval Hard 30.8, BFCL 88.8, Global MMLU 64.1. All evaluations zero-shot unless stated otherwise, run with lighteval.

useCases: Should be used as assistive tools rather than definitive sources of information; users should verify important information. The model is an instruct model optimized for hybrid reasoning.

Can be used in agentic systems with tool calling (xml_tools or python_tools), as an instruct/hybrid reasoning model, and deployed via vLLM and SGLang as an OpenAI-compatible API; should be used as an assistive tool.
technicalLimitations: Generated content may not always be factually accurate, logically consistent, or free from biases present in the training data; should be used as assistive tools rather than definitive sources, and users should verify important information.
out_of_scope_uses: The model should be used as an assistive tool rather than a definitive source of information; users should verify important information.

data.description:
data_provenance: Pretraining used a staged curriculum of web, code, math and reasoning data, with a public data mixture; pretraining datasets are in a public collection. Mid-training used 140B reasoning tokens; mid-training and post-training datasets will be uploaded later.
data_acquisition: Pretrained on 11.2T tokens with a staged curriculum of web, code, math and reasoning data; post-training included midtraining on 140B reasoning tokens, then supervised fine-tuning and alignment via Anchored Preference Optimization (APO). Pretraining datasets are public in a collection; mid-training and post-training datasets will be uploaded later.
data_scope: Pretrained on 11.2T tokens with a staged curriculum of web, code, math and reasoning data; midtraining on 140B reasoning tokens. Trained on English, French, Spanish, German, Italian and Portuguese as main languages, plus fewer tokens of Arabic (standard), Chinese and Russian data.
